Bacterial Spot.symptoms: Small dark spots on leaves and fruit, sometimes surrounded by yellowing.
immediate_actions: Remove badly affected leaves and dispose of them away from the crop.
Avoid working among wet plants to reduce spread.
prevention: Use clean seed and healthy seedlings.
Water at soil level and provide good airflow.
Bacterial Spot.warning: Follow locally approved agricultural guidance and product labels. Ask a local agriculture officer before applying any treatment.

Early Blight.symptoms: Brown leaf spots with concentric rings, often beginning on older lower leaves.
immediate_actions: Remove affected lower leaves and clear fallen plant debris.
Keep foliage dry and improve spacing or airflow.
prevention: Use mulch to reduce soil splash.
Rotate away from tomato and potato crops.
Water near the soil rather than over the leaves.
Early Blight.warning: Follow locally approved agricultural guidance and product labels. Ask a local agriculture officer before applying any treatment.

Late Blight.symptoms: Water-soaked dark patches on leaves and stems that can expand quickly in cool, wet conditions.
immediate_actions: Isolate and remove severely affected plant material.
Avoid overhead irrigation and inspect nearby plants frequently.
prevention: Remove volunteer tomato and potato plants.
Use resistant varieties when available locally.
Late Blight.warning: Late blight can spread rapidly. Follow locally approved agricultural guidance and product labels, and contact an agriculture officer promptly.

Healthy.symptoms: No disease pattern was detected in the uploaded image.
immediate_actions: Continue regular crop scouting, especially on new leaves and fruit.

prevention: Water consistently at the soil level.
Maintain airflow with suitable spacing and staking.
Use clean tools and healthy planting material.
